answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the lantern of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The hollow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
